channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Maurice Cheeks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Maurice Cheeks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
Royce Young:Pop on Mo Cheeks and his Hall of Fame candidacy:

“He’s one of the greatest of all time to me... his demeanor was always perfect.”

Gregg Popovich on Maurice Cheeks, Mar 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
Fred Katz:Billy Donovan on the Sixers honoring Mo Cheeks, who is getting a statue at the practice facility, and why he grew up a fan of Cheeks' Sixers:

“[He] certainly brought a lot of success to this city, to this organization and I’m just happy they’re honoring him.”

Billy Donovan on Maurice Cheeks, Dec 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
Erik Horne:Russell Westbrook on Mo Cheeks getting his own sculpture outside the Sixers practice facility:

“It’s an unbelievable honor. Cheeks has been an unbelievable mentor to me, someone I look up to.”

Russell Westbrook on Maurice Cheeks, Dec 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
Matt Barnes on Maurice Cheeks:

“He was such a dick. He just wasn't cool, I really didn't like him, like I still to this day like I'll slap him in his face if he says anything to me type shit.”

Matt Barnes on Maurice Cheeks, Sep 20, 2016. Source: The Vertical.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
“I came down on a 3-on-1 and hit pull-up 15-footer off the glass and [Cheeks] stopped practice,”

Matt Barnes on Maurice Cheeks, Apr 10, 2015. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Kim English on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
“It’s the right thing. You want discipline. You want to do everything the right way and, without a doubt, it will be done the right way with coach Cheeks.”

Kim English on Maurice Cheeks, Jun 15, 2013. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Jeff Van Gundy on Maurice Cheeks
item.description:
Alex Kennedy:Jeff Van Gundy:

“Maurice Cheeks was so good when I coached him, I named my cat after him. He died 18 years later.”

Jeff Van Gundy on Maurice Cheeks, Jun 13, 2012. Source: Twitter.
